about.title: About Turn2 Specialty Companies
text: We believe our people are our most important asset, which is why we're home to the top management, supervision, and craft in the industry. “Proven People. Proven Results.” is more than just our motto, it’s our core value.
With over 40 years in the refining, chemical, fertilizer, power industries, Joe is an expert in all types of turnarounds and capital projects.

Working his way from helper, to welder, to the President of one of the largest turnaround service providers in the industry, Joe believes that integrity and transparency are the keys to successful partnerships.
